name: @odaclick/skill-respec
description: Use when auditing an existing codebase or Unity game to document how it works TODAY (AS-IS) as methodology-agnostic ground-truth before any spec-driven development. Produces a cross-linked docs/ bundle whose mandatory core is the minimum docs contract (docs/architecture.md + design.md + references/ + adr/, the architect-before-spec gate) plus domain docs, observations, glossary and an optional TO-BE layer. Triggers — "audit this project", "document how this works", "reverse-engineer this", "pre-SDD docs", "respec".
